<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="315" y1="17" x2="315" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="17" x2="320" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="344" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="348" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="11" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#96E063"/>
  <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="32,59 24,67 32,75" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Boost</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="88" x2="390" y2="88" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Promotional artwork card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="101" width="354" height="188" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="18" y="97" width="354" height="188" rx="20" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="66" cy="133" r="25" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.16"/>
  <circle cx="328" cy="245" r="36" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="311" cy="125" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="245" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>

  <polygon points="304,183 309,195 321,199 309,203 304,216 299,203 287,199 299,195" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <polygon points="238,113 243,125 255,129 243,133 238,146 233,133 221,129 233,125" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.75"/>

  <!-- Illustration profile cards -->
  <rect x="103" y="125" width="82" height="108" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.92" transform="rotate(-10 144 179)"/>
  <circle cx="143" cy="157" r="19" fill="#D0CECD"/>
  <circle cx="143" cy="151" r="8" fill="#939393"/>
  <ellipse cx="143" cy="169" rx="15" ry="9" fill="#939393"/>
  <rect x="124" y="187" width="39" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <rect x="130" y="198" width="28" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#EAEDF1"/>

  <rect x="206" y="116" width="91" height="120" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" transform="rotate(9 251 176)"/>
  <circle cx="251" cy="153" r="22" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  <circle cx="251" cy="146" r="9" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="251" cy="165" rx="18" ry="11" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <rect x="225" y="188" width="52" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <rect x="233" y="201" width="36" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <polygon points="190,166 202,187 194,187 200,204 183,181 191,181" fill="#FE3675"/>

  <text x="195" y="259" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Be seen by more people</text>
  <text x="195" y="278" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Get up to 10× more profile views</text>

  <!-- Pagination -->
  <circle cx="181" cy="303" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="303" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <circle cx="209" cy="303" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <!-- Package card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="324" width="354" height="190" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="18" y="320" width="354" height="190" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <circle cx="55" cy="362" r="23" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <polygon points="55,345 61,359 70,363 61,367 55,381 49,367 40,363 49,359" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="91" y="357" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">10 Boosts</text>
  <text x="91" y="379" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">$3.00 each</text>
  <rect x="279" y="342" width="70" height="26" rx="13" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
  <text x="314" y="359" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#C42936">POPULAR</text>

  <text x="350" y="432" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">$30.00</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="40" y="454" width="310" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">SELECT</text>
  </g>

  <text x="22" y="550" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Why use Boost?</text>
  <text x="349" y="550" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">How it works</text>

    <circle cx="44" cy="583" r="18" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
    <polygon points="44,569 49,580 57,584 49,588 44,598 39,588 31,584 39,580" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="75" y="579" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Stand out instantly</text>
    <text x="75" y="597" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Your profile appears near the top</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="22" y1="617" x2="368" y2="617" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <circle cx="44" cy="646" r="18" fill="#FF7854" opacity="0.16"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="640" r="5" fill="#FF7854"/>
    <ellipse cx="44" cy="652" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FF7854"/>
    <text x="75" y="642" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">More profile views</text>
    <text x="75" y="660" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Connect with more potential matches</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="702" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Boosts are activated immediately after purchase.</text>
  <text x="195" y="718" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Payment will be charged to your account.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Discover -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="784" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="789" x2="44" y2="779" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="39" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="782" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <line x1="117" y1="793" x2="123" y2="799" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="793" x2="123" y2="799" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="123" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>

    <rect x="181" y="776" width="20" height="15" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="191" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Boost active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="268" cy="784" r="14" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
    <polygon points="268,770 273,781 281,784 273,787 268,798 263,787 255,784 263,781" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="268" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Boost</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="779" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="793" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="345" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
